Awards & Achievements

Kai Shing swept half of the awards at Residential Clubhouse Management Awards 2023 Winning two Gold Awards for the first time

Kai Shing Management Services Limited (Kai Shing) remarkably won half of the awards in the "Residential Club Management Awards 2023" organised by the Hong Kong Recreation Management Association recently. Dynasty Court and YOHO Midtown have garnered the Gold awards in two categories (The number of Residential Units is 1,000 or less; or above), while Ultima and Riva received the Silver and Distinction awards in Category I respectively. The award ceremony is widely recognized in the industry to highlight outstanding residential clubhouse services. With the record-breaking results received this year, Kai Shing's excellent clubhouse has been affirmed once again.

Kai Shing has been committed to providing the highest quality property management services, aiming to create a comfortable, safe and healthy living environment for residents to enjoy their lives. Dynasty Court, the Gold award winner in Category I, is a renowned luxury residential estate in the district. The clubhouse covers an area of 20,000 square feet, serving residents of over 400 units. To ensure residents can experience the best clubhouse services, the management team of Dynasty Court has developed their team's service motto "Creating a Cosy Home with Heart", upgrading clubhouse services to the next level and ensuring the standards of the club environment, facility quality, and safety and hygiene are met. The team has conducted regular maintenance, refurbishment of various facilities to meet the growing needs of residents, aiming to give them a refreshed feeling. Meanwhile, the team has also regularly organised activities for residents in different age groups, such as Christmas Carnival, Children's Workshops, and Health Seminars etc. In addition, the clubhouse restaurant has also received an incredible amount of compliments on its Chinese and Western cuisines, with regularly updated menus and custom-made dishes to provide a fresh experience for residents. These efforts have earned the clubhouse much praise from its residents.

YOHO Midtown, the Gold award winner in Category II, has a four-storey clubhouse covering a total area of over 220,000 square feet, serving residents of over 1,800 units. Taking care of a large amount of resident population is not an easy task, however, the management team at YOHO Midtown has always put in great effort to serve residents with heart, together with their service attitudes of bringing happiness to all. In addition to regular facility maintenance, the team has renovated the club and introduced innovative technologies in due course, such as delivery robots, QR code self-ordering system and self-service ticketing system etc., providing residents with faster and more convenient services. The team has also actively pursued various environmental certifications, including Gold Seal for Contribution to Sustainable Property / Facility and Indoor Air Quality Certificate etc., ensuring the environmental quality in clubhouse remains at its best. The team has also attached great importance to the safety of residents when using facilities, such as setting guidelines to monitor pool safety and placing automated external defibrillators (AED) in the lobby, doing their utmost to protect residents' safety and health.

Over the years, Kai Shing has regarded residential clubhouse service as an important part of property management. Adhering to "Building Homes with Heart", the philosophy of Sun Hung Kai Properties, our parent company, the clubhouse services we offer are professional, attentive and innovative, to ensure the needs of residents are fully met, while at the same time proactively integrate sustainable development into property management services to promote a green culture.

The awards, which have been widely recognised since the inception in 2011, and Kai Shing's management team has repeatedly received numerous accolades, however, it still sparks great excitement and encouragement for the team in achieving two Gold awards this year! In future, Kai Shing will continue to strive for innovation in clubhouse services to create more thoughtful and surprising experiences, bringing residents more happiness!

The award list of "Residential Clubhouse Management Awards 2023" :

Category Awarded Property
Category I : The number of Residential Units is 1,000 or less Gold Award : Dynasty Court
Silver Award : Ultima
Distinction : Riva
Category II : The number of Residential Units above 1,000 Gold Award : YOHO Midtown
